description: Starts a separate session for a side topic from a short brief rather than copying the whole conversation, so this session stays on topic and its context stops growing. Use only for /spinoff, a message that starts with "spinoff", "spin-off" or "spin off" without the slash, "spin this off", "hand this off to a new session", or "take this to its own session". Does not trigger automatically. Not a conversation fork or branch (those copy the whole chat), not a sub-agent, not a checkpoint.
